name: Holst
title: Grand Master

villagemaster/32199.htm.text: Grand Master Holst: Welcome. I am Grand Master Holst. If you are one of the Kamael who has left his own land, you should take a moment to reflect on whether you have behaved dishonorably or endangered a fellow Kamael. Be honest, now. Search yourself...

links.text: Use a shadow weapon exchange coupon.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32199-01.htm.text: Holst: Why have you come looking for me? Did you see anyone suspicious pass by? I heard what happened in the Town of Gludio, but I haven't seen anyone suspicious here. Why you are asking?

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32199-03.htm.text: Holst: He is faster than I thought. Follow him while I go tell the head of the security. It looks as though he is running toward the northwestern side. If he passed the northwestern gate, the gate guards must have seen him. Go ask them.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32199-04.htm.text: Holst: Have you talked to the guards at the northwestern gate of Dion? Go ask them.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32199-02.htm.text: Holst: The Hierarch asked me to...suspicious person...don't know what to do...perhaps the man who who receives the freight information...
